description: A local MCP server is initialized and called, while a remote plain HTTP login is rejected.
prompt: List the MCP tools, call hello, and try the specified login.

setup_home_files.config.toml:
provider = "vllm"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1"
model = "e2e-model"
[mcp.servers.fake]
command = "python"
args = ["{workspace}/fake_mcp.py"]
read_only = true
